name: AK22A - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Large Screen, Grid Display
highlights: The Largest Screen in the Range — 166 × 108 mm of body, nearly all of it display. Every reading is sized to be read standing up, from the other side of a room, without leaning in.

Six Values Tiled, None Subordinate — The grid layout gives CO₂, particulates, formaldehyde, TVOC and the climate readings equal weight. Nothing is buried in a corner, which suits a technician scanning for the one value that has moved.
Laser Particulate Split — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 measured and displayed separately, with clock and AQI.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge. The device is designed to sit rather than travel — the battery covers a working day away from the socket.
21 Per Carton — The largest enclosure in the range, so the carton count is lower; 515.5 × 445.5 × 223 mm outer, 14.9 kg gross.

specs.Readings: CO2, PM2.5, HCHO, TVOC, temperature, humidity, AQI
